# W markers 
```{r markers}
markers <- read_tsv("./Input_files/Wmarkers_assemblies_selected.tsv")


# markers %>% ggplot() +
#   geom_point(aes(x=strain, y=align_len), size = 2) +
#   facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 1) +
#   ylim (600, 1400) +
#   xlab("Silkworm Strain") + ylab("Alignment Length (bp)") +
#   theme_light(12)

fig2 <- markers %>% ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=strain, y=align_len), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 1) +
  ylim (600, 1400) +
  xlab("Silkworm Strain") + ylab("Alignment Length (bp)") +
  theme_light(12)

print(fig2)
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  "Fig2.tiff",
  plot   =fig2,
  device = ragg::agg_tiff,
  width  = 85, height = 90, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  compression = "lzw" 
)


ggsave(
  "Fig2.png",
  plot   = fig2,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  width  = 85, height = 90, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  #compression = "lzw" 
)
```

# Mitochondrial DNA

```{r mtDNA}
tbl <- read_tsv("./Input_files/Bombyx_mit_accno_species.tsv", col_names = c("Acc", "Taxon"))


alignment <- read.dna("./Input_files/Bombyx_mt_all_align_Gblock.fasta", format = "fasta")

alignment <- DNAbin2genind(alignment)

matrix <- tab (alignment, freq = FALSE, NA.method = "mean")
rownames(matrix) <- gsub(" .+", "", rownames(matrix))


pca_res <- prcomp(matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(pca_res$x[,1:2])
pca_df$Acc <- rownames(pca_df)
pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  merge(tbl, by="Acc")

pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  mutate(Taxon=fct_relevel(as.factor(Taxon), "mandarina", "mori", "p50ma", "p50T")) %>%
  arrange (Taxon != "p50T")


# pca_df %>% 
# ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Taxon)) +
#   geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha =0.7) +
#   geom_point(data = subset(pca_df, Taxon == "p50T"), size = 1.5, alpha = 1) +
#   xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)")) +
#   ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)")) +
#   theme_light(12) +
#   theme(legend.text = element_text(face="italic"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   scale_color_manual(values = c( "#AA4499", "#6699CC", "#117733", "black"))

fig3 <- pca_df%>% 
ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Taxon)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha =0.7) +
  geom_point(data = subset(pca_df, Taxon == "p50T"), size = 1.5, alpha = 1) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)")) +
  theme_light(12) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face="italic"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "#AA4499", "#6699CC", "#117733", "black"))

print(fig3)

```

```{r}

  plot   = fig3,
  device = ragg::agg_tiff,
  width  = 85, height = 65, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  compression = "lzw" 
)


ggsave(
  "Fig3.png",
  plot   = fig3,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  width  = 85, height = 65, units = "mm",
  res    = 300
  #compression = "lzw"
```
